summary: Tower Semiconductor filed a Form 6-K on August 4, 2026, announcing Q2 2026 financial results. Revenue was $460 million (24% YoY growth), with record gross profit of $138 million, operating profit of $90 million, and net profit of $91 million ($0.79 diluted EPS). The company guided Q3 2026 revenue to $520 million (31% YoY growth) and raised its 2028 target to $3.6 billion revenue with $1.2 billion net profit. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special-situation event. No strategic review, acquisition, divestiture, or capital return was disclosed. The filing is purely operational and financial, with no transaction terms or deal mechanics to analyze.
